//#region src/json.ts
function canonical(value) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) return "[" + value.map(canonical).join(",") + "]";
	if (value && typeof value === "object") return "{" + Object.entries(value).filter(([, v]) => v !== void 0).sort(([a], [b]) => a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0).map(([key, v]) => JSON.stringify(key) + ":" + canonical(v)).join(",") + "}";
	return JSON.stringify(value);
}

}).superRefine((v, c) => {
	const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), roles = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
	for (const e of v.endpoints) {
		if (ids.has(e.endpointId)) c.addIssue({
			code: "custom",
			message: "Duplicate endpointId"
		});
		ids.add(e.endpointId);
		if (e.role) {
			if (roles.has(e.role)) c.addIssue({
				code: "custom",
				message: "Duplicate workflow role"
			});
			roles.add(e.role);
		}
	}
});

//#region src/candidate-material-protocol.ts
const original$2 = {
	principalId: opaqueKey,
	operationId: ids.operation
};
const step = {
	...original$2,
	ordinal: z.number().int().min(0).max(29)
};
const bound$5 = {
	...step,
	requestHash: sha256
};
const file = {
	path: managedSourcePath,
	version: z.string().regex(/^(ours|theirs|base\.[a-f0-9]{40}|stage\.[123])$/)
};
const candidateMaterialDescriptor = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
	z.strictObject({
		kind: z.literal("REPORT"),
		mergeSha256: sha256,
		sha256,
		byteSize: z.number().int().min(1).max(32 * 1024 * 1024)
	}),
	z.strictObject({
		kind: z.literal("FILE"),
		...file,
		objectId: gitCommit,
		mode: z.enum(["100644", "100755"]),
		sha256,
		byteSize: z.number().int().min(0).max(2 * 1024 * 1024)
	}),
	z.strictObject({
		kind: z.literal("DIRECTORY"),
		...file,
		objectId: gitCommit
	}),
	z.strictObject({
		kind: z.literal("ABSENT"),
		...file
	})
]);
function candidateMaterialKey(descriptor) {
	return descriptor.kind === "REPORT" ? "report" : createHash("sha256").update(descriptor.version + "\0" + descriptor.path).digest("hex");
}
const candidateMaterialTarget = {
	operationId: ids.operation,
	ordinal: step.ordinal,
	materialKey: z.union([z.literal("report"), sha256])
};
const candidateMaterialRequests = {
	getCandidateMaterial: z.strictObject({
		...original$2,
		...candidateMaterialTarget
	}),
	declareCandidateMaterials: z.strictObject({
		...bound$5,
		materials: z.array(candidateMaterialDescriptor).min(1).max(100)
	}),
	listCandidateMaterials: z.strictObject({
		...step,
		afterKey: z.string().max(64).default(""),
		limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(100)
	}),
	sealCandidateConflictMaterials: z.strictObject({
		...bound$5,
		materialCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(2e4),
		manifestSha256: sha256
	}),
	acknowledgeCandidateConflict: z.strictObject({
		...bound$5,
		proof: z.strictObject({
			repositoryIdentity: gitDirectoryIdentity,
			reportSha256: sha256,
			manifestSha256: sha256,
			materialCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(2e4)
		})
	})
};
const candidateMergeReport = z.strictObject({
	clean: z.boolean(),
	tree: gitCommit,
	base: gitCommit.nullable(),
	bases: z.array(gitCommit).min(1).max(64),
	ours: gitCommit,

//#region src/workspace-domain.ts
const time = () => (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString();
function fail$2(code, status = 409) {
	throw new StorageError(code, status, "Managed workspace action could not be applied");
}
function createWorkspaceDomain(db) {
	const get = (sql, ...p) => db.prepare(sql).get(...p), exec = (sql, ...p) => db.prepare(sql).run(...p);
	const repository = (id) => get("SELECT * FROM managed_repositories WHERE project_id=?", id) ?? fail$2("MANAGED_REPOSITORY_NOT_FOUND", 404);
	const workspace = (operationId) => get("SELECT * FROM workspace_allocations WHERE operation_id=?", operationId) ?? fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
	function member(projectId, principalId, write = false) {
		const m = get("SELECT role FROM project_members WHERE project_id=? AND principal_id=?", projectId, principalId);
		if (!m || write && m.role === "viewer") fail$2("WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED", 403);
	}
	const repoView = (r) => ({
		projectId: String(r.project_id),
		resourceId: String(r.resource_id),
		operationId: String(r.operation_id),
		requestHash: String(r.request_hash),
		templateCommit: String(r.template_commit),
		state: String(r.state),
		identity: r.identity_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.identity_json)) : null,
		manifest: r.manifest_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.manifest_json)) : null
	});
	const view = (r) => ({
		workspaceRef: String(r.workspace_ref),
		operationId: String(r.operation_id),
		projectId: String(r.project_id),
		runId: String(r.run_id),
		attemptId: String(r.attempt_id),
		activationId: String(r.activation_id),
		grantId: String(r.grant_id),
		runnerId: String(r.runner_id),
		kind: r.kind,
		baseCommit: String(r.base_commit),
		scope: JSON.parse(String(r.scope_json)),
		requestHash: String(r.request_hash),
		state: String(r.state),
		identity: r.identity_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.identity_json)) : null,
		manifest: r.manifest_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.manifest_json)) : null,
		errorCode: r.error_code
	});
	function owned(r, p) {
		if (p.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt" || p.runId !== r.run_id || p.attemptId !== r.attempt_id || p.activationId !== r.activation_id || p.grantId !== r.grant_id || !p.resources.some((v) => v.kind === "workspace" && v.resourceId === r.workspace_ref)) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
		const grant = get("SELECT permit_json FROM execution_grants WHERE grant_id=?", p.grantId), current = grant ? parseContract(executionPermit, JSON.parse(String(grant.permit_json))) : null;
		if (!current || current.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt" || p.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt" || current.workId !== p.workId || current.runEpoch !== p.runEpoch || current.workEpoch !== p.workEpoch) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
		const owner = get("SELECT owner_id FROM projects WHERE project_id=?", r.project_id);
		if (!owner) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
		member(String(r.project_id), String(owner.owner_id));
	}
	function manifestValid(m, commit) {
		const { sha256, ...basis } = m;
		if (m.commit !== commit || sha256 !== digest(canonical(basis)) || m.byteSize !== m.files.reduce((n, f) => n + f.byteSize, 0) || new Set(m.files.map((f) => f.path.toLowerCase())).size !== m.files.length) fail$2("WORKSPACE_SOURCE_MANIFEST_INVALID");
	}
	function identityValid(identity) {
		if (![
			identity.root,
			identity.gitDirectory,
			identity.commonDirectory
		].every(isAbsolute)) fail$2("WORKSPACE_IDENTITY_INVALID");
	}
	function overlaps(a, b) {
		const norm = (p) => process.platform === "win32" ? p.toLowerCase() : p;
		const inside = (parent, child) => {
			const r = relative(norm(parent), norm(child));
			return r === "" || r !== ".." && !r.startsWith(".." + sep) && !isAbsolute(r);
		};
		return inside(a, b) || inside(b, a);
	}
	const handlers = {
		beginManagedRepository(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				member(i.projectId, i.principalId, true);
				const requestHash = digest(canonical(i)), old = get("SELECT * FROM managed_repositories WHERE project_id=? OR operation_id=? OR resource_id=?", i.projectId, i.operationId, i.resourceId);
				if (old) {
					if (old.request_hash !== requestHash) fail$2("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED");
					return {
						...repoView(old),
						created: false
					};
				}
				if (!get("SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN user_tasks t ON t.project_id=p.project_id WHERE p.project_id=? AND p.accepted_release_id IS NULL AND t.kind='NEW' AND t.base_commit=?", i.projectId, i.templateCommit)) fail$2("MANAGED_REPOSITORY_BASE_CHANGED");
				const now = time();
				exec("INSERT INTO managed_repositories VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,'PREPARING',NULL,NULL,?,?)", i.projectId, i.resourceId, i.operationId, requestHash, i.templateCommit, now, now);
				return {
					...repoView(repository(i.projectId)),
					created: true
				};
			});
		},
		completeManagedRepository(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const r = get("SELECT * FROM managed_repositories WHERE operation_id=?", i.operationId) ?? fail$2("MANAGED_REPOSITORY_NOT_FOUND", 404);
				if (r.request_hash !== i.requestHash) fail$2("MANAGED_REPOSITORY_BASIS_CHANGED");
				manifestValid(i.manifest, String(r.template_commit));
				identityValid(i.identity);
				if (i.identity.root !== i.identity.gitDirectory || i.identity.root !== i.identity.commonDirectory) fail$2("MANAGED_REPOSITORY_IDENTITY_INVALID");
				if (r.state === "READY") {
					if (r.identity_json !== canonical(i.identity) || r.manifest_json !== canonical(i.manifest)) fail$2("MANAGED_REPOSITORY_RESULT_IMMUTABLE");
					return repoView(r);
				}
				exec("UPDATE managed_repositories SET state='READY',identity_json=?,manifest_json=?,updated_at=? WHERE operation_id=?", canonical(i.identity), canonical(i.manifest), time(), i.operationId);
				return repoView(repository(String(r.project_id)));
			});
		},
		getManagedRepository(i) {
			member(i.projectId, i.principalId);
			return repoView(repository(i.projectId));
		},
		beginWorkspaceAllocation(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const { permit: p, ...basis } = i, requestHash = digest(canonical({
					...basis,
					owner: {
						runId: p.ownerKind === "workflowAttempt" ? p.runId : null,
						attemptId: p.ownerKind === "workflowAttempt" ? p.attemptId : null,
						activationId: p.activationId,
						grantId: p.grantId
					}
				})), old = get("SELECT * FROM workspace_allocations WHERE operation_id=? OR workspace_ref=?", i.operationId, i.workspaceRef);
				if (old) {
					owned(old, p);
					if (old.request_hash !== requestHash) fail$2("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED");
					return {
						...view(old),
						created: false
					};
				}
				if (p.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt") fail$2("WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED", 403);
				const h = get(`SELECT a.*,r.project_id,r.run_epoch,r.control_gate,r.terminal_outcome,w.work_epoch,w.blocked_reason,p.owner_id,g.status AS grant_status,g.permit_json
        FROM attempts a JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=a.run_id JOIN works w ON w.run_id=a.run_id AND w.work_id=a.work_id
        JOIN projects p ON p.project_id=r.project_id JOIN execution_grants g ON g.attempt_id=a.attempt_id AND g.activation_id=? AND g.grant_id=? WHERE a.attempt_id=? AND a.run_id=?`, p.activationId, p.grantId, p.attemptId, p.runId);
				if (!h || h.grant_status !== "ACTIVE" || h.control_gate !== "OPEN" || h.terminal_outcome !== null || h.ended_at !== null || h.blocked_reason !== null || h.run_epoch !== p.runEpoch || h.work_epoch !== p.workEpoch) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ADMISSION_CLOSED", 403);
				member(String(h.project_id), String(h.owner_id), true);
				const current = parseContract(executionPermit, JSON.parse(String(h.permit_json)));
				assertPermit(p, current, {
					kind: "workspace",
					resourceId: i.workspaceRef,
					access: "write"
				}, Date.now());
				assertPermit(p, current, {
					kind: "projectRepository",
					resourceId: i.repositoryResourceId,
					access: "read"
				}, Date.now());
				if (i.kind === "development" && h.role !== "developer" || i.kind === "verification" && h.role !== "tester") fail$2("WORKSPACE_ROLE_DENIED", 403);
				if (JSON.parse(String(h.input_manifest_json)).codeCommit !== i.baseCommit) fail$2("WORKSPACE_BASE_CHANGED");
				const repo = repository(String(h.project_id));
				if (repo.state !== "READY" || repo.resource_id !== i.repositoryResourceId) fail$2("MANAGED_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE");
				const work = get("SELECT definition_json FROM work_revisions WHERE run_id=? AND work_id=? AND revision=?", p.runId, p.workId, Number(h.work_revision)), scope = parseContract(approvedWorkspaceScope, JSON.parse(String(work?.definition_json)).writeScope), now = time();
				if (i.kind === "development" && !scope.length) fail$2("WORKSPACE_SCOPE_EMPTY", 403);
				exec("INSERT INTO workspace_allocations VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'PREPARING',NULL,NULL,NULL,?,?)", i.workspaceRef, i.operationId, String(h.project_id), p.runId, p.attemptId, p.activationId, p.grantId, i.runnerId, i.kind, i.baseCommit, canonical(scope), requestHash, now, now);
				return {
					...view(workspace(i.operationId)),
					created: true
				};
			});
		},
		getWorkspaceAllocation(i) {
			const r = workspace(i.operationId);
			owned(r, i.permit);
			return view(r);
		},
		getAllocationRepository(i) {
			const r = workspace(i.operationId);
			owned(r, i.permit);
			return repoView(repository(String(r.project_id)));
		},
		authorizeWorkspaceAllocation(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const r = workspace(i.operationId), p = i.permit;
				owned(r, p);
				if (p.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt") fail$2("WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED", 403);
				const h = get(`SELECT r.run_epoch,r.control_gate,r.terminal_outcome,w.work_epoch,w.blocked_reason,a.ended_at,g.status,g.permit_json,p.owner_id
        FROM attempts a JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=a.run_id JOIN works w ON w.run_id=a.run_id AND w.work_id=a.work_id
        JOIN projects p ON p.project_id=r.project_id JOIN execution_grants g ON g.attempt_id=a.attempt_id AND g.activation_id=? AND g.grant_id=? WHERE a.attempt_id=? AND a.run_id=?`, p.activationId, p.grantId, p.attemptId, p.runId);
				if (!h || h.status !== "ACTIVE" || h.control_gate !== "OPEN" || h.terminal_outcome !== null || h.ended_at !== null || h.blocked_reason !== null || h.run_epoch !== p.runEpoch || h.work_epoch !== p.workEpoch) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ADMISSION_CLOSED", 403);
				member(String(r.project_id), String(h.owner_id), true);
				const current = parseContract(executionPermit, JSON.parse(String(h.permit_json))), repo = repository(String(r.project_id));
				assertPermit(p, current, {
					kind: "workspace",
					resourceId: String(r.workspace_ref),
					access: "write"
				}, Date.now());
				assertPermit(p, current, {
					kind: "projectRepository",
					resourceId: String(repo.resource_id),
					access: "read"
				}, Date.now());
				return view(r);
			});
		},
		completeWorkspaceAllocation(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const r = workspace(i.operationId);
				if (r.request_hash !== i.requestHash) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_BASIS_CHANGED");
				manifestValid(i.manifest, String(r.base_commit));
				if (r.state === "READY") {
					if (r.identity_json !== canonical(i.identity) || r.manifest_json !== canonical(i.manifest)) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_RESULT_IMMUTABLE");
					return view(r);
				}
				if (!["PREPARING", "RECONCILE"].includes(String(r.state))) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_CLOSED");
				const repo = repository(String(r.project_id)), repositoryIdentity = JSON.parse(String(repo.identity_json));
				identityValid(i.identity);
				if (overlaps(i.identity.root, repositoryIdentity.root) || i.identity.gitDirectory !== join(i.identity.root, ".git") || i.identity.commonDirectory !== i.identity.gitDirectory) fail$2("WORKSPACE_IDENTITY_INVALID");
				exec("UPDATE workspace_allocations SET state='READY',identity_json=?,manifest_json=?,error_code=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE operation_id=?", canonical(i.identity), canonical(i.manifest), time(), i.operationId);
				return view(workspace(i.operationId));
			});
		},
		markWorkspaceAllocationUncertain(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const r = workspace(i.operationId);
				if (r.request_hash !== i.requestHash) fail$2("WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_BASIS_CHANGED");
				if (["PREPARING", "RECONCILE"].includes(String(r.state))) exec("UPDATE workspace_allocations SET state='RECONCILE',error_code=?,updated_at=? WHERE operation_id=?", i.errorCode, time(), i.operationId);
				return view(workspace(i.operationId));
			});
		}
	};
	return { execute(method, input) {
		return handlers[method](parseContract(workspaceRequests[method], input));
	} };
}

function fail$1() {
	throw new StorageError("MCP_AUTHORITY_DENIED", 403, "Current tool authority is unavailable");
}
const cleanup = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
	"tests.get",
	"tests.stop",
	"tests.by-operation",
	"issues.get",
	"issues.by-operation",
	"pipeline.get",
	"pipeline.logs",
	"pipeline.artifacts",
	"pipeline.stop",
	"pipeline.by-operation",
	"repo.by-operation",
	"repo.fileByOperation"
]);
function createToolAuthorityDomain(db) {
	const get = (sql, ...p) => db.prepare(sql).get(...p);
	function check(permit, toolName, action, workspaceMaintenance = false) {
		if (permit.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt") fail$1();
		const h = get(`SELECT a.*,r.project_id,r.run_epoch,r.control_gate,r.terminal_outcome,w.work_epoch,w.blocked_reason,
      g.status AS grant_status,g.permit_json,p.owner_id,m.role AS membership FROM attempts a JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=a.run_id
      JOIN works w ON w.run_id=a.run_id AND w.work_id=a.work_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id=r.project_id
      JOIN project_members m ON m.project_id=p.project_id AND m.principal_id=p.owner_id
      JOIN execution_grants g ON g.attempt_id=a.attempt_id AND g.activation_id=? AND g.grant_id=? WHERE a.attempt_id=? AND a.run_id=?`, permit.activationId, permit.grantId, permit.attemptId, permit.runId);
		if (!h || h.membership === "viewer") fail$1();
		const current = parseContract(executionPermit, JSON.parse(String(h.permit_json)));
		if (current.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt") fail$1();
		if ([
			"runId",
			"runEpoch",
			"workId",
			"workEpoch",
			"attemptId",
			"activationId",
			"grantId"
		].some((k) => permit[k] !== current[k])) fail$1();
		if (permit.resources.some((r) => !current.resources.some((c) => c.kind === r.kind && c.resourceId === r.resourceId && (c.access === "write" || r.access === "read")))) fail$1();
		const role = JSON.parse(String(h.role_snapshot_json));
		const modelName = toolName.replaceAll(".", "_"), isCleanup = workspaceMaintenance || cleanup.has(toolName) && action !== "write";
		if (!workspaceMaintenance && !role.allowedTools.includes(modelName) && !role.allowedTools.includes(toolName) && !(isCleanup && role.allowedTools.some((t) => t.startsWith(toolName.split(".")[0] + "_") || t.startsWith(toolName.split(".")[0] + ".")))) fail$1();
		if (!isCleanup) {
			if (h.grant_status !== "ACTIVE" || h.control_gate !== "OPEN" || h.terminal_outcome !== null || h.ended_at !== null || h.blocked_reason !== null || h.run_epoch !== permit.runEpoch || h.work_epoch !== permit.workEpoch) fail$1();
			for (const resource of permit.resources) assertPermit(permit, current, resource, Date.now());
			if (!get(`SELECT 1 FROM accepted_work w JOIN a2a_tasks t ON t.endpoint_id=w.endpoint_id AND t.task_id=w.task_id
        JOIN a2a_task_ownership o ON o.endpoint_id=t.endpoint_id AND o.task_id=t.task_id
        WHERE t.attempt_id=? AND w.activation_id=? AND w.state='ACTIVE' AND o.cancel_requested=0`, permit.attemptId, permit.activationId)) fail$1();
		}
		return {
			principalId: String(h.owner_id),
			projectId: String(h.project_id),
			runId: permit.runId,
			host: h
		};
	}
	function refresh(original, toolName, action) {
		const g = get("SELECT permit_json FROM execution_grants WHERE grant_id=?", original.grantId);
		if (!g) fail$1();
		const current = parseContract(executionPermit, JSON.parse(String(g.permit_json)));
		if (original.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt" || current.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt" || [
			"runId",
			"runEpoch",
			"workId",
			"workEpoch",
			"attemptId",
			"activationId",
			"grantId"
		].some((k) => original[k] !== current[k])) fail$1();
		const permit = parseContract(executionPermit, {
			...current,
			resources: original.resources
		});
		check(permit, toolName, action);
		return permit;
	}
	return {
		check,
		refresh,
		workspaceMaintenance: (permit) => check(permit, "repo.by-operation", "read", true)
	};
}

const decimal = z.string().regex(/^\d+$/).max(32);

	device: decimal,
	fileId: decimal

const path = z.string().min(1).max(1024);
const mode = z.number().int().min(0).max(511);
const workspaceMaterialEntry = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
	z.strictObject({
		kind: z.literal("FILE"),
		path,
		identity: workspaceMaterialIdentity,
		mode,
		links: z.number().int().min(1).max(8e3),
		mtimeNs: z.string().regex(/^-?\d+$/).max(32),
		ctimeNs: z.string().regex(/^-?\d+$/).max(32),

	}),

		kind: z.literal("DIRECTORY"),

		identity: workspaceMaterialIdentity,

	}),

		path
	}),
	z.strictObject({
		kind: z.literal("EXCLUDED"),

		reason: z.enum(["retained-git-repository", "rebuildable-node-modules"]),
		identity: workspaceMaterialIdentity
	})
]);

	identity: workspaceMaterialIdentity,

function fail(code, status = 409) {
	throw new StorageError(code, status, "Complete original workspace preservation is required");
}
const same = (a, b) => canonical(a) === canonical(b);
function workspacePreservationMaterialKey(path) {
	return digest(path);
}
function createWorkspacePreservationDomain(db) {
	const get = (sql, ...p) => db.prepare(sql).get(...p), all = (sql, ...p) => db.prepare(sql).all(...p), exec = (sql, ...p) => db.prepare(sql).run(...p);
	const workspaces = createWorkspaceDomain(db), authority = createToolAuthorityDomain(db);
	const required = (id) => get("SELECT * FROM workspace_preservations WHERE operation_id=?", id) ?? fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
	function membership(projectId, principalId, write) {
		const m = get("SELECT role FROM project_members WHERE project_id=? AND principal_id=?", projectId, principalId);
		if (!m || write && m.role === "viewer") fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
	}
	function owner(r, p) {
		const h = authority.workspaceMaintenance(p);
		membership(String(r.project_id), h.principalId, true);
		if (h.principalId !== r.principal_id) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
		if (workspaces.execute("getWorkspaceAllocation", {
			permit: p,
			operationId: String(r.allocation_operation_id)
		}).workspaceRef !== r.workspace_ref) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
		return r;
	}
	const view = (r) => ({
		operationId: String(r.operation_id),
		allocationOperationId: String(r.allocation_operation_id),
		workspaceRef: String(r.workspace_ref),
		principalId: String(r.principal_id),
		requestHash: String(r.request_hash),
		basisSha256: String(r.basis_hash),
		state: r.state,
		basis: JSON.parse(String(r.basis_json)),
		manifest: r.manifest_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.manifest_json)) : null,
		acknowledgement: r.acknowledgement_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.acknowledgement_json)) : null,
		acknowledgedAt: r.acknowledged_at
	});
	function inputs(i) {
		const h = authority.workspaceMaintenance(i.permit), allocation = workspaces.execute("getWorkspaceAllocation", {
			permit: i.permit,
			operationId: i.allocationOperationId
		}), repository = workspaces.execute("getAllocationRepository", {
			permit: i.permit,
			operationId: i.allocationOperationId
		});
		membership(allocation.projectId, h.principalId, true);
		if (allocation.projectId !== h.projectId || allocation.state !== "READY" || !allocation.identity || !allocation.manifest || repository.state !== "READY" || !repository.identity) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE");
		const p = i.permit;
		if (p.ownerKind !== "workflowAttempt" || !p.resources.some((r) => r.kind === "workspace" && r.resourceId === allocation.workspaceRef) || !p.resources.some((r) => r.kind === "projectRepository" && r.resourceId === repository.resourceId)) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_OWNER_DENIED", 403);
		const operations = all("SELECT * FROM repo_operations WHERE attempt_id=? ORDER BY operation_id", allocation.attemptId);
		if (operations.some((r) => r.run_id !== allocation.runId || r.activation_id !== allocation.activationId || r.grant_id !== allocation.grantId || !["SUCCEEDED", "FAILED"].includes(String(r.state)))) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_GIT_UNKNOWN");
		const commits = [];
		for (const r of operations) {
			if (r.tool_name !== "repo.commit" || r.state !== "SUCCEEDED") continue;
			const prepared = r.prepared_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.prepared_json)) : null, result = r.result_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.result_json)) : null, request = JSON.parse(String(r.request_json));
			if (!prepared || result?.commit !== prepared.commit || prepared.ref !== "refs/devmesh/operations/" + r.operation_id || request.binding.workspaceRef !== allocation.workspaceRef || request.binding.baseCommit !== allocation.baseCommit) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_SOURCE_UNPROVEN");
			const saved = all("SELECT * FROM source_archives WHERE allocation_operation_id=? AND commit_operation_id=? AND state='ACKNOWLEDGED' ORDER BY rowid", allocation.operationId, r.operation_id).at(0);
			commits.push({
				operationId: String(r.operation_id),
				requestHash: String(r.request_hash),
				commit: prepared.commit,
				tree: prepared.tree,
				ref: prepared.ref,
				archive: saved ? {
					operationId: String(saved.operation_id),
					manifest: JSON.parse(String(saved.manifest_json)),
					acknowledgement: JSON.parse(String(saved.acknowledgement_json))
				} : null
			});
		}
		if (commits.length > 64) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_TOO_MANY_COMMITS");
		const files = all("SELECT * FROM repo_file_operations WHERE workspace_ref=? ORDER BY operation_id", allocation.workspaceRef);
		if (files.some((r) => r.run_id !== allocation.runId || r.attempt_id !== allocation.attemptId || r.activation_id !== allocation.activationId || r.grant_id !== allocation.grantId) || files.length > 8e3) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_OWNER_DENIED", 403);
		return {
			principalId: h.principalId,
			allocation,
			repository,
			commits,
			fileOperations: files.map((r) => ({
				operationId: String(r.operation_id),
				requestHash: String(r.request_hash),
				state: String(r.state),
				cleanupConfirmed: r.cleanup_confirmed === 1,
				proof: r.prepared_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.prepared_json)) : null,
				result: r.result_json ? JSON.parse(String(r.result_json)) : null
			}))
		};
	}
	function current(r, permit) {
		owner(r, permit);
		if (digest(canonical(inputs({
			permit,
			allocationOperationId: String(r.allocation_operation_id)
		}))) !== r.basis_hash) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_BASIS_CHANGED");
	}
	const material = (t) => get("SELECT * FROM workspace_preservation_materials WHERE operation_id=? AND material_key=?", t.operationId, t.materialKey) ?? fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_MATERIAL_NOT_FOUND", 404);
	const materialView = (r) => ({
		operationId: String(r.operation_id),
		materialKey: String(r.material_key),
		sha256: String(r.expected_hash),
		byteSize: Number(r.byte_size),
		writeKey: String(r.write_key),
		contentHash: r.content_hash,
		writeId: r.write_id
	});
	function contentReady(operationId) {
		const items = all("SELECT * FROM workspace_preservation_materials WHERE operation_id=?", operationId);
		if (!items.length || items.some((r) => !r.content_hash || !get("SELECT 1 FROM content_objects WHERE content_hash=? AND byte_size=? AND state='READY'", r.expected_hash, r.byte_size))) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_MATERIAL_UNAVAILABLE");
		return items.length;
	}
	function validateManifest(r, m) {
		const b = view(r).basis, a = b.allocation, repo = b.repository, { sha256, ...snapshot } = m.snapshot;
		if (m.operationId !== r.operation_id || m.allocationOperationId !== a.operationId || m.workspaceRef !== a.workspaceRef || m.basisSha256 !== r.basis_hash || m.headCommit !== a.baseCommit || !same(m.repositoryIdentity, repo.identity) || !same(m.workspaceIdentity, a.identity) || digest(canonical(snapshot)) !== sha256 || m.snapshot.byteSize !== m.snapshot.entries.reduce((n, e) => n + (e.kind === "FILE" ? e.byteSize : 0), 0) || new Set(m.snapshot.entries.map((e) => e.path.toLowerCase())).size !== m.snapshot.entries.length || Buffer.byteLength(canonical(m)) > 8 * 1024 * 1024) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_MANIFEST_CHANGED");
		const expected = [{
			ref: "refs/devmesh/workspace-preservations/" + r.operation_id + "/base",
			commit: a.baseCommit,
			manifest: a.manifest
		}, ...b.commits.map((c) => {
			if (!c.archive) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_SOURCE_UNRETAINED");
			return {
				ref: c.archive.acknowledgement.archiveRef,
				commit: c.commit,
				manifest: c.archive.manifest
			};
		})];
		if (!same(m.retained, expected)) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_SOURCE_UNRETAINED");
	}
	function assertReclaimable(i) {
		const r = owner(required(i.operationId), i.permit), record = view(r);
		if (r.state !== "ACKNOWLEDGED" || r.manifest_hash !== i.manifestSha256) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_ACK_REQUIRED");
		current(r, i.permit);
		if (record.basis.fileOperations.some((f) => !f.cleanupConfirmed || !["SUCCEEDED", "FAILED"].includes(f.state))) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_FILE_UNKNOWN");
		if (contentReady(i.operationId) !== record.acknowledgement.materialCount) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_ACK_UNPROVEN");
		return record;
	}
	const handlers = {
		getWorkspacePreservationInputs(i) {
			return inputs(i);
		},
		beginWorkspacePreservation(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const old = get("SELECT * FROM workspace_preservations WHERE operation_id=?", i.operationId);
				if (old) {
					owner(old, i.permit);
					if (old.allocation_operation_id !== i.allocationOperationId) fail("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED");
					return {
						...view(old),
						created: false
					};
				}
				if ([
					"repo_operations",
					"repo_file_operations",
					"workspace_allocations",
					"source_archives",
					"candidate_integrations"
				].some((table) => get("SELECT 1 FROM " + table + " WHERE operation_id=?", i.operationId))) fail("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED");
				const b = inputs(i);
				if (b.commits.some((c) => !c.archive)) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_SOURCE_UNRETAINED");
				const basis = canonical(b), basisHash = digest(basis), requestHash = digest(canonical({
					allocationOperationId: i.allocationOperationId,
					principalId: b.principalId
				}));
				if (get("SELECT 1 FROM workspace_preservations WHERE workspace_ref=? AND state<>'ACKNOWLEDGED'", b.allocation.workspaceRef)) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED");
				exec("INSERT INTO workspace_preservations(operation_id,allocation_operation_id,workspace_ref,project_id,principal_id,request_hash,basis_hash,basis_json,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'SENT',?)", i.operationId, i.allocationOperationId, b.allocation.workspaceRef, b.allocation.projectId, b.principalId, requestHash, basisHash, basis, (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString());
				return {
					...view(required(i.operationId)),
					created: true
				};
			});
		},
		getWorkspacePreservation(i) {
			return view(owner(required(i.operationId), i.permit));
		},
		prepareWorkspacePreservation(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const r = owner(required(i.operationId), i.permit);
				if (r.request_hash !== i.requestHash) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_REQUEST_CHANGED");
				validateManifest(r, i.manifest);
				const serialized = canonical(i.manifest);
				if (r.manifest_json) {
					if (r.manifest_json !== serialized) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_MANIFEST_CHANGED");
					return view(r);
				}
				current(r, i.permit);
				if (r.state !== "SENT") fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_CLOSED");
				const materials = [{
					key: "manifest",
					sha256: digest(serialized),
					byteSize: Buffer.byteLength(serialized)
				}, ...i.manifest.snapshot.entries.filter((e) => e.kind === "FILE").map((e) => ({
					key: workspacePreservationMaterialKey(e.path),
					sha256: e.sha256,
					byteSize: e.byteSize
				}))];
				exec("UPDATE workspace_preservations SET state='PREPARED',manifest_json=?,manifest_hash=? WHERE operation_id=?", serialized, digest(serialized), i.operationId);
				for (const item of materials) exec("INSERT INTO workspace_preservation_materials(operation_id,material_key,expected_hash,byte_size,write_key) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", i.operationId, item.key, item.sha256, item.byteSize, randomUUID());
				return view(required(i.operationId));
			});
		},
		listWorkspacePreservationMaterials(i) {
			owner(required(i.operationId), i.permit);
			return all("SELECT * FROM workspace_preservation_materials WHERE operation_id=? AND material_key>? ORDER BY material_key LIMIT ?", i.operationId, i.afterKey, i.limit).map(materialView);
		},
		completeWorkspacePreservation(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => {
				const r = owner(required(i.operationId), i.permit), record = view(r), m = record.manifest, ack = i.acknowledgement;
				if (!m || r.request_hash !== i.requestHash || ack.manifestSha256 !== r.manifest_hash || ack.snapshotSha256 !== m.snapshot.sha256 || !same(ack.repositoryIdentity, m.repositoryIdentity) || !same(ack.workspaceIdentity, m.workspaceIdentity) || !same(ack.parentIdentity, m.snapshot.identity)) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_ACK_UNPROVEN");
				if (r.state === "ACKNOWLEDGED") {
					if (!same(record.acknowledgement, ack)) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_ACK_IMMUTABLE");
					return record;
				}
				if (r.state !== "PREPARED") fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_CLOSED");
				current(r, i.permit);
				if (contentReady(i.operationId) !== ack.materialCount) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_ACK_UNPROVEN");
				exec("UPDATE workspace_preservations SET state='ACKNOWLEDGED',acknowledgement_json=?,acknowledged_at=? WHERE operation_id=?", canonical(ack), (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), i.operationId);
				return view(required(i.operationId));
			});
		},
		assertWorkspacePreservationReclaimable(i) {
			return transaction(db, () => assertReclaimable(i));
		}
	};
	return {
		assertReclaimable,
		authorize(principalId, t) {
			const r = required(t.operationId);
			membership(String(r.project_id), principalId, true);
			if (r.principal_id !== principalId) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_NOT_FOUND", 404);
			return material(t);
		},
		validateWrite(i) {
			const r = this.authorize(i.meta.principalId, i.target);
			if (i.meta.scopeId !== i.target.operationId || i.meta.idempotencyKey !== r.write_key || i.expectedHash !== r.expected_hash || i.expectedSize !== r.byte_size) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_WRITE_CHANGED");
		},
		commit(principalId, t, hash, writeId) {
			const r = this.authorize(principalId, t);
			if (r.expected_hash !== hash || r.content_hash && r.write_id !== writeId) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_WRITE_CHANGED");
			exec("UPDATE workspace_preservation_materials SET content_hash=?,write_id=? WHERE operation_id=? AND material_key=?", hash, writeId, t.operationId, t.materialKey);
			return {
				operationId: t.operationId,
				materialKey: t.materialKey,
				contentHash: hash
			};
		},
		resolve(principalId, t) {
			const r = required(t.operationId);
			membership(String(r.project_id), principalId, false);
			const m = material(t);
			if (!m.content_hash) fail("WORKSPACE_PRESERVATION_MATERIAL_UNAVAILABLE");
			return { content_hash: m.content_hash };
		},
		execute(method, input) {
			return handlers[method](parseContract(workspacePreservationRequests[method], input));
		}
	};
}

const candidate = {
	candidateId: ids.candidate,
	candidateRevision: revision,
	manifestHash: sha256,
	reviewHash: sha256,
	expectedAcceptedReleaseId: ids.release.nullable(),
	dataPlanHash: sha256
};
const bound$1 = {
	principalId: opaqueKey,
	operationId: ids.operation,
	requestHash: sha256
};
const acceptanceBackendPolicy = z.strictObject({
	schemaVersion: z.literal("devmesh.acceptance-backend.v1"),
	backendPrincipalId: opaqueKey,
	backendRef: opaqueKey,
	runnerId: opaqueKey,
	templateVersion: opaqueKey,
	schemaRevision: opaqueKey,
	initialModes: z.array(z.enum(["EMPTY", "DEMO"])).max(2),
	allowPreserveMigration: z.boolean(),
	allowReplacement: z.boolean()
}).refine((p) => new Set(p.initialModes).size === p.initialModes.length);
const acceptancePreparationRequest = z.strictObject({
	schemaVersion: z.literal("devmesh.acceptance-prepare.v1"),
	operationId: ids.operation,
	releaseId: ids.release,
	projectId: ids.project,
	runId: ids.run,
	...candidate,
	runEpoch: epoch,
	requirementRevision: revision,
	planRevision: revision,
	codeCommit: gitCommit,
	image: previewImageIdentity,
	dataPlan: deliveryDataPlan,
	policyHash: sha256,
	backendPrincipalId: opaqueKey,
	backendRef: opaqueKey,
	runnerId: opaqueKey,
	source: z.strictObject({
		releaseId: ids.release,
		datasetId: ids.dataset,
		datasetOperationId: ids.operation,
		storageKey: z.string().max(512),
		schemaRevision: opaqueKey
	}).nullable(),
	target: z.strictObject({
		datasetId: ids.dataset,
		storageKey: z.string().max(512),
		schemaRevision: opaqueKey
	})
}).superRefine((i, c) => {
	if (i.image.targetCommit !== i.codeCommit || i.dataPlan.codeCommit !== i.codeCommit || i.dataPlan.runId !== i.runId || i.dataPlan.requirementRevision !== i.requirementRevision || i.dataPlan.planRevision !== i.planRevision || i.dataPlan.sourceReleaseId !== i.expectedAcceptedReleaseId || i.target.storageKey !== i.projectId + "/" + i.target.datasetId + "/app.sqlite") c.addIssue({
		code: "custom",
		message: "Exact candidate, data plan and derived target required"
	});
	if ((i.source?.releaseId ?? null) !== i.expectedAcceptedReleaseId || i.source && (i.source.datasetId === i.target.datasetId || i.source.storageKey !== i.projectId + "/" + i.source.datasetId + "/app.sqlite")) c.addIssue({
		code: "custom",
		message: "Exact distinct original accepted source required"
	});
});
const acceptanceRequests = {
	registerAcceptanceBackendPolicy: z.strictObject({
		principalId: opaqueKey,
		projectId: ids.project,
		policy: acceptanceBackendPolicy
	}),
	recordAcceptanceReplacementDecision: z.strictObject({
		...conditional,
		...candidate,
		decisionId: ids.decision,
		confirmation: z.literal("REPLACE_ACCEPTED_DATA")
	}),
	beginAcceptancePreparation: z.strictObject({
		...conditional,
		...candidate,
		policyHash: sha256
	}),
	getAcceptancePreparation: z.strictObject({
		principalId: opaqueKey,
		operationId: ids.operation
	}),
	listAcceptancePreparations: z.strictObject({
		principalId: opaqueKey,
		projectId: ids.project,
		policyHash: sha256,
		afterSequence: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
		limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(20)
	}),
	markAcceptancePreparationSent: z.strictObject({
		...bound$1,
		expectedRevision: revision
	}),
	markAcceptancePreparationUnknown: z.strictObject({
		...bound$1,
		expectedRevision: revision,
		errorCode: opaqueKey
	}),
	failUnsentAcceptancePreparation: z.strictObject({
		...conditional,

	}),
	listAcceptancePreparationHistory: z.strictObject({
		...bound$1,
		afterSequence: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
		limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(20)
	})
};

/** Only a trusted adapter may construct this after querying its original objects. */
const acceptancePreparedProof = z.strictObject({
	schemaVersion: z.literal("devmesh.acceptance-prepared.v1"),

	requestHash: sha256,

//#region src/preview-session-protocol.ts
const previewOrigin = z.string().max(2048).refine((value) => {
	try {
		const u = new URL(value);
		return ["http:", "https:"].includes(u.protocol) && u.origin === value && !u.username && !u.password && !u.hostname.endsWith(".");
	} catch {
		return false;
	}
});
const gateway = {
	principalId: opaqueKey,
	gatewayId: opaqueKey,
	configurationHash: sha256
};
const origins = {
	platformOrigin: previewOrigin,
	previewOrigin
};
const previewSessionRequests = {
	issuePreviewTicket: z.strictObject({
		...gateway,
		...origins,
		subjectPrincipalId: opaqueKey,
		runId: ids.run,
		previewId: ids.preview,
		ticketId: opaqueKey,
		tokenSha256: sha256,
		expiresAt: timestamp
	}),
	exchangePreviewTicket: z.strictObject({
		...gateway,
		...origins,
		ticketTokenSha256: sha256,
		sessionId: opaqueKey,
		sessionTokenSha256: sha256,
		expiresAt: timestamp
	}),
	authenticatePreviewSession: z.strictObject({
		...gateway,
		previewOrigin,
		tokenSha256: sha256
	}),
	revokePreviewSession: z.strictObject({
		...gateway,
		previewOrigin,
		tokenSha256: sha256
	})
};
